resources.string:
1. Share sheet: in Instagram or X, tap Share and pick "Fix embed". The fixed link is copied to the clipboard.

2. Text selection menu: select text containing an Instagram or X link, open the selection menu's overflow ("More") and pick "Fix embed". In editable fields the link is replaced in place; otherwise the fixed link is copied.

3. Quick Settings tile: copy an Instagram or X link, then tap the "Fix link" tile (add it via the Quick Settings edit button). The clipboard is replaced with the fixed link.
